sources.label: Test patches
sources.author: Edoardo9708
patch_list: Prezzi Benzina - Custom signer response F6 (ARM64)
Experimental: use a user-supplied public X.509 DER/Base64 certificate in the locally returned PackageInfo. Does not re-sign APK or alter server verification. Do not combine with F5.
Prezzi Benzina - Entitlement diagnostics D1
Logs original Premium, price history and ads decisions without modifying purchases or feature access.
Prezzi Benzina - Gadget only F7 (ARM64)
Experimental stability test: load Frida Gadget without Java bridge, Java hooks or certificate override. Does not fix Google Maps. Do not combine with F5/F6.
Prezzi Benzina - Java bridge only F8 (ARM64)
Experimental stability test: load Frida Gadget and run Java.perform only, without Java hooks or certificate override. Does not fix Maps. Do not combine with F5/F6/F7.
Prezzi Benzina - Method lookup only F10 (ARM64)
Experimental: resolve getPackageInfo(String,int) with Java.use, without installing any hook or modifying signatures. Do not combine with F5/F6/F7/F8/F9.
Prezzi Benzina - microG token routing F13
Local test: route only Maps ApiTokenService to the existing app.revanced.android.gms and declare the original public certificate digest. No Frida; use alone, not with F5-F12.
Prezzi Benzina - No-op PackageInfo hook F9 (ARM64)
Experimental stability test: intercept getPackageInfo(String,int) but return original PackageInfo unchanged. No certificate modification. Does not fix Maps. Use F9 alone, not with F5-F8.
Prezzi Benzina - Personal Google Maps key M1
Replace the Maps SDK manifest API key with your own Google Cloud key. Enter it in patch options; no certificate spoofing.
Prezzi Benzina - Remove ads A1
Test: disables banner and interstitial ads without changing Premium, licenses or in-app purchases.
Prezzi Benzina - Signature trace F5 (ARM64)
Experimental read-only inspection of returned PackageInfo signing certificates (SHA-1/SHA-256) and call stacks. No signature changes.
